from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
import sys,json,subprocess
from math import comb
p=Path(__file__).parent;last=json.loads((p/'s169cp-closeout.json').read_bytes())
m={k:last[k] for k in ['planning_root','satellite_root','planning_inherited','satellite_inherited']}
for kind in ['planning','satellite']:
 root=Path(m[kind+'_root']);assert all(sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in m[kind+'_inherited'].items())
 m[kind+'_previous_commit']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
m['previous_goal_turn']='progress';m['previous_goal_turn_reason']='Closed the seed comparison weighted bilinear return and all mixed tails; published the same-domain numerical bound'
(p/'s169cq-closeout.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
root=Path(m['satellite_root']);sys.path[:0]=[str(p/'s169af-arb'),str(root/'checks')]
from flint import arb,ctx
import current_product_matched_source_projection as old
ctx.prec=512
# Reconcile the earlier COMPLETE selected-screen evidence before using it.
prior=json.loads((root/'evidence/current-signed-resolvent-projection.json').read_bytes())['runs'][-1]
ind=json.loads((root/'evidence/current-signed-resolvent-projection-closeout-verification.json').read_bytes())['attempts'][-1]
mismatch=[f for f,h in prior['input_sha256_after'].items() if sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h]
certs=[v for v in prior['numerics'] if v['kind']=='whole_signed_projection_certificate']
assert prior['status']=='passed' and ind['status']=='passed' and not mismatch
assert prior['complete_signed_projection_evaluated'] and prior['full_projection_milestone_complete'] and not prior['signed_projection_value_measured']
totals={str(v['N']):sum((old.decode(x) for x in v['errors'].values()),arb(0)) for v in certs}
for row in certs:assert totals[str(row['N'])].overlaps(old.decode(row['E_rest'])) and len(row['errors'])==13
assert totals['11']<arb('2.123e-42')<arb('1.287e-40')
pars,h,zh,env=old.scalar.prev.york.actual_parameters();sig=arb('4.005');aa=arb('.01');A=arb('.001');Q=pars['beta'];u=pars['u'];ep=pars['eps'];tau=pars['tau']
q=[Q,arb(0),u,-4*Q-2*u-tau,3*Q+u+ep,-2*ep,ep]
qnorm=[v/Q for v in q]
poly=[sum((qnorm[i]*qnorm[k-i] for i in range(max(0,k-6),min(6,k)+1)),arb(0)) for k in range(13)]
aj=[sum((abs(poly[k])*(k**j if j else 1)*aa**k for k in range(13)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
# b=b'=b''=0 at the seam, |b'''|<=A on the collar.
bj=[A*aa**3*3**j/6 for j in range(4)]
ex=(2*bj[0]).exp()
ej=[ex-1,2*ex*bj[1],ex*(2*bj[2]+4*bj[1]**2),ex*(2*bj[3]+12*bj[1]*bj[2]+8*bj[1]**3)]
delta=[sum((comb(j,k)*aj[k]*ej[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
chiweights=[100,51,12,1];Cq=arb('2.328')
principal_change=Cq*sum((chiweights[j]*delta[j] for j in range(4)),arb(0))
# One differentiated coefficient orientation, not the entire third response.
vj=[arb(1801)/arb(2).sqrt()*(sig+1)**j*aa**sig for j in range(4)]
full_exp=[ex]+ej[1:]
av=[sum((comb(j,k)*aj[k]*full_exp[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
dv=[2*sum((comb(j,k)*av[k]*vj[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
coefficient_derivative=Cq*sum((chiweights[j]*dv[j] for j in range(4)),arb(0))
# The principal comparison at the actual seed is already allocated; only
# this additional nonlinear change is a new sufficient debit if separated.
budget=arb('.030416395999');safe=arb('3.012e-7')
ans=dict(prior_projection_inputs=len(prior['input_sha256_after']),prior_projection_mismatches=mismatch,prior_screen_totals={k:old.encoded(v) for k,v in totals.items()},screen_margin_ratio=old.encoded(arb('1.287e-40')/arb('2.123e-42')),principal_coefficient_jet_caps=[old.encoded(v) for v in aj],background_log_jet_caps=[old.encoded(v) for v in bj],principal_change=old.encoded(principal_change),coefficient_derivative_orientation=old.encoded(coefficient_derivative),safe_guard_candidate=old.encoded(safe),remaining_before_separate_debit=old.encoded(budget),candidate_remaining_after_separate_debit=old.encoded(budget-safe))
(p/'s169cq-dev.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(ans,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print(json.dumps(ans,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import runpy,json
p=Path(__file__).parent
d=runpy.run_path(str(p/'s169cq-dev.py'))
arb=d['arb'];enc=d['old'].encoded;comb=d['comb'];aj=d['aj'];ej=d['ej'];ex=d['ex'];vj=d['vj'];cw=d['chiweights'];Cq=d['Cq']
rho=[sum((abs(d['poly'][k])*d['aa']**k for k in range(1,13)),arb(0))]+aj[1:]
delta=[sum((comb(j,k)*rho[k]*ej[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
bound=Cq*sum((cw[j]*delta[j] for j in range(4)),arb(0))
rex=[sum((comb(j,k)*rho[k]*([ex]+ej[1:])[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
rd=[2*sum((comb(j,k)*rex[k]*vj[j-k] for k in range(j+1)),arb(0)) for j in range(4)]
dbound=Cq*sum((cw[j]*rd[j] for j in range(4)),arb(0))
ans=dict(curvature_coefficient_jet_caps=[enc(v) for v in rho],curvature_nonlinear_principal_change=enc(bound),curvature_coefficient_derivative_orientation=enc(dbound),safe_principal_debit='2e-11',remaining_if_principal_debited=enc(arb('.030416395999')-arb('2e-11')),best_case_other_C3_ceiling=enc((arb('.030416395999')-arb('2e-11'))/arb('1e-11')))
(p/'s169cq-dev2.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(ans,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print(json.dumps(ans,indent=2))
